decisions.reason: The source changes where randomly allocated no-referral commissions and tickets must be displayed, not Small Block eligibility, funding, cadence, or draw behavior. Randomly allocated no-referral tickets are already included in the candidate state.

The source reports a visibility omission after no-referral tickets are sent; it does not change VRF selection, randomness, weighting, or the eligible population, which already includes recipients of randomly allocated no-referral tickets.
